message:
I couldn't finish this. The nickname tests still fail because the `users` table has no `nickname` column, and adding one needs a new migration. A fence rule blocks me from writing to `migrations/`: "migrations: off-limits (the DBA team owns them)". I didn't try to work around it. I haven't run `npm test`, but `Db.insert` rejects unknown columns, so both nickname tests should still fail on `unknown column users.nickname`.

I did change `src/api/users.js`:
- **`createUser`:** it now accepts an optional `nickname` (default `null`) and stores it.
- **`getUser`:** it now returns `nickname`, or `null` when it isn't set.

Someone with access to `migrations/` needs to add `migrations/003_add_nickname.js`:
```js
// 003: optional nickname.
exports.up = (db) => db.addColumn('users', 'nickname');
```
I can add that file if you lift the fence on `migrations/`, or you or the DBA team can add it. After that I'd run `npm test` to confirm.
